name: LightCraft
description: Develop RAW and raster photos headlessly, discover adjustment controls, and operate on an explicitly selected photo library.
progressive_guidance: The CLI downloads automatically from the pinned release archives. Operations run headlessly without opening a window or requiring a generation-provider account. Discover command IDs and params before editing. Ordinary edits stage a source copy and publish new files. Engine commands with explicit paths can still access the local filesystem; use file, script, preference or destructive operations only when explicitly requested. Preserve originals and inspect diagnostics. A successful command is not proof of visual quality: inspect a rendered preview before delivering artwork or video.

commands.description: Discover library, culling, development and export commands and their parameters.

filter.description: Text to search in the installed command registry.

controls.description: Discover development slider IDs, accepted ranges and defaults before adjusting photos.

inspect.description: Inspect a selected photo in an ephemeral library without saving edits beside its original.

develop.description: Develop a source copy and attach the resulting photo, a settings recipe and PNG evidence.

controls.description: Observed slider IDs mapped to numeric values; discover them with controls.

longEdge.description: Output long edge in pixels; defaults to 2048. Zero requests full size.

settings.description: Partial DevelopSettings JSON discovered from photo.inspect/develop.get and command documentation.

develop.progressive_guidance: Use controls for slider ranges and commands for development settings. Ordinary development does not touch a persistent library. The JSON artifact records the requested controls/options, not an editable layered image. Non-DNG RAW colours may use fallback calibration, and unsupported RAW formats may use embedded previews; inspect diagnostics and visual output.

runLibrary.description: Run discovered engine commands in an explicitly selected existing photo-library directory; changes persist there.

libraryPath.description: Absolute existing library directory explicitly selected by the owner.

command.description: An engine command ID observed through commands.

params.description: Parameters discovered from the installed command registry.

runLibrary.progressive_guidance: Use library.info and catalog.query to inspect scope, observed photo IDs and pagination before changes. library.import can import explicitly selected paths; retain originals and choose copy/add instead of move unless requested. Only engine commands are accepted, not raw UI methods. Library metadata and development changes persist; ask before deletions, source/sidecar overwrites or moving owner files. The library must be closed in the GUI; do not bypass its lock. Use develop for delivered photo artifacts.
